extra.summary: The KrisFlyer UOB Credit Card accelerates your miles earning, especially if you frequently fly Singapore Airlines or Scoot. Unlock 3 miles per S$1 spend on dining, food delivery, online shopping, online travel and transport spend, with min. $1,000 annual spend on Singapore Airlines, Scoot and KrisShop. This makes it ideal for everyday spending, not just flights. While the base earn rate is 1.2 miles per S$1, the boosted rates offer substantial value, if you maximize bonus categories.

our_takes.our-take: The KrisFlyer UOB Credit Card accelerates your miles earning, especially if you frequently fly Singapore Airlines or Scoot. Unlock 3 miles per S$1 spend on dining, food delivery, online shopping, online travel and transport spend, with min. $1,000 annual spend on Singapore Airlines, Scoot and KrisShop. This makes it ideal for everyday spending, not just flights. While the base earn rate is 1.2 miles per S$1, the boosted rates offer substantial value, if you maximize bonus categories. Consider pairing with the KrisFlyer UOB Account for even more miles. Annual fee is waived for the first year.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent flyers aiming to maximize KrisFlyer miles on Singapore Airlines and Scoot flights and earn travel perks.
Diners and online shoppers looking to accelerate miles earnings through dining, food delivery and online purchases with minimum annual spending.
Salary earners wanting to boost miles by crediting their salary into a KrisFlyer UOB Account and maximizing miles on daily spend.
our_takes.things-to-note:
The annual fee is $196.20; factor this into your spending to ensure rewards outweigh the cost.
A 3.25% foreign transaction fee applies; use a card with no fee for overseas spending instead.
Late payment fees are S$100; avoid these by setting up payment reminders to pay on time.
Insured up to S$100k by SDIC.
